messages:
alex wong: Quick follow-up from the monthly recurring-incident analysis. I pulled a 90-day rollup and the top 3 recurring themes are: deployment flakiness, KV cache thrashing, and autoscale misconfig collisions. Spreadsheet with raw counts + traces: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/recurring-incidents-90d

maria gonzalez: I can take deployment flakiness. Plan: 1) PR a postmortem follow-up doc (EOD Wed), 2) add deploy-time healthchecks + stricter preflight (2w), 3) quick rollback playbook (1w). Will also add a dashboard for deploy success/failure rate. @sahil @jen any dependencies?

sahil patel: I’ll own KV cache thrashing. Immediate steps: increase eviction margin, enable per-model KV size metrics, run perf sweep. Hotfix path: tweak eviction threshold and restart policy (could be a 2w hotfix). Full mitigation (LRU improvements + tests) ~4w. No blocking deps on deploy work.

jen li: I’ll take autoscale config collisions. Observed when burst traffic + mixed model pools cause oversubscription. Short-term: tighten scale-in cooldowns and add surge-protection policy (2w). Longer-term: policy engine change for capacity hints (8-12w). Affected Dedicated customers include 3 accounts — need to sync with AMs.

ops-bot: Incident rollup doc created: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/recurring-rollup-1769201111 (automated summary attached)

alex wong: Proposed remediation timelines: quick wins <=2 weeks, medium fixes 3-6 weeks, major rework 8-12 weeks. Can each owner confirm realistic ETA and if they need help from eng-infra or eng-runtime?

maria gonzalez: Confirming ETAs above. Will need one staging slot for deploy experiments (canary). Also want to add a deploy-gate alert in PagerDuty (critical if >3 failures in 10m).

sahil patel: ETA: hotfix 2w, full mitigation 4w. Will need eng-runtime help to add per-model KV metrics; filing ticket now.

jen li: ETA: surge-protection policy 2w, policy engine change 10w. Need one eng-infra engineer for canary capacity during testing.

alex wong: I opened infra ticket #INF-4321 to request staging capacity and bumped eng-runtime ticket #RUNTIME-278. Also added a row in the remediation tracker: https://redwood.example.com/trackers/remediations (see row ID 78)

maria gonzalez: Quick checklist for follow-up:
- [ ] Postmortem follow-up doc (maria)
- [ ] Deploy healthchecks + gate (maria)
- [ ] KV metrics + eviction hotfix (sahil)
- [ ] Autoscale surge policy (jen)
- [ ] Weekly sync (alex)

sahil patel: I'll attach a minimal repro + perf logs to the tracker by Fri.

jen li: I'll coordinate with AMs and draft the customer communication before any config change. ETA for draft: Tue next week.

alex wong: OK — I'll compile these into the remediation tracker and kick off a weekly 30min check-in starting next Wed to keep momentum. If anyone hits a blocker please post here and tag @eng-infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria gonzalez: Sounds good. Will update tracker when PRs are opened.

sahil patel: +1

jen li: Thanks — will post the canary plan once infra confirms capacity.

ops-bot: Reminder: next review in 30 days.
